notes: Correct, but it retrofits suffix handling with double lookups in squashfs New/NewObject and adds symlink-specific EOF handling to zip Open, which is heavier than needed; tests are extensive but the escape test only checks a sentinel and not that an error is returned.

Works, but squashfs lookup is more convoluted than needed (exact/link entry matching, Readlink via interface assertion, Info called twice), and zip Open gains an offset clamp that changes behaviour for regular files too; tests are thorough and include a committed image so they run without mksquashfs.
Code is essentially identical to the reference; it adds relevant docs and tests for zip and squashfs listing plus an end-to-end hostile-archive escape test (the squashfs test needs mksquashfs).

Functional, using a double-lookup NewObject/New approach, but a squashfs link seek past its length errors instead of clamping, a missing StatT silently yields an empty target, and the squashfs test changes the process working directory with os.Chdir.

Clean, focused fix for both zip and squashfs; List and NewObject agree and range/seek on links is clamped, though zip now treats a symlink-mode entry with a trailing slash as a link instead of a directory, and one squashfs range assertion is never checked.
